title: Reinhard Gehlen, Knight of Malta, put in charge of West German intelligence by the OSS

as_told.title: Gehlen Organization absorbed into the CIA

plain: After the Second World War, the claim goes, American intelligence took over Reinhard Gehlen, who had run the Third Reich's spying against the Soviet Union, along with his whole network. A guest named Dan Sheehan tells Michels that Gehlen was "the head of the anti-Soviet" intelligence for the Nazis, and his version has the OSS, the American wartime spy service, putting Gehlen in charge of West German intelligence; the story's title also calls Gehlen a Knight of Malta, a Catholic order of knights. A researcher named Jason Jorjani tells it differently: the OSS made "a deal with General Gehlen to absorb his entire Nazi spy network in Eastern Europe as part of the creation of the CIA". If true, it would mean Nazi intelligence men were built into the American and West German spy services from the start.
